ticks.note: Both blinkers are ticked every 250 ms. Tick 1: `t` = 0, the LED is off.
`t` = 500: both LEDs come on. `Blink` resets the clock on the way (`t` = 0); `BlinkForgetful` does not (`t` = 500).
`Blink`: `t` = 250. `BlinkForgetful`: `t` = 750, already past 500, so its LED goes off again after only 250 ms.
`Blink`: `t` = 500, so the LED goes off after 500 ms on, and `t` = 0 again. `BlinkForgetful`: `t` = 1000, and its LED is on again: from now on, every timeout test it makes is already true.
`Blink` comes on after 500 ms off; `BlinkForgetful` flips on.
`Blink` keeps its rhythm, 500 ms on and 500 ms off. `BlinkForgetful` flips in every tick.
